newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU investigates aid to Italy's Keller SpA.
newsitem.headline: EU investigates aid to Italy's Keller SpA.

text.p: The European Commission decided on Wednesday to investigate restructuring aid to Italian firms Keller Spa and Keller Meccanica SpA, makers of rolling stock.

The European Union executive said the procedure regards the granting of two soft loans for a total amount of 40.34 billion Italian lira and proposed Italian treasury guarantees aimed at covering 50 percent of the soft-loans.

"On the basis of the information currently available, the Commission cannot exclude that these aids fulfil all the conditions for restructuring aid to be considered compatible with the common market," it said in a statement.
Both companies were part of the Gruppo Keller, but were declared insolvent in 1994 and are now submitted to "extraordinary administrative arrangements," the Commission said.
